cohort: The study participants were all women experiencing deliveries at a tertiary healthcare center over a one-year period from March 2022 to February 2023.
finding: The incidence of uterine rupture was 0.25% (18 out of 7200 deliveries), and a prior cesarean scar was identified as the most significant risk factor.
mod_finding: The presence of a prior cesarean scar (a previous mode of birth) was found to be the most significant risk factor for uterine rupture.
